questions.prompt: A codemode script calls prices once and returns three numbers. What enters the model's context?
options: All 250 prices and the three numbers
Only the three numbers the script returned
Nothing, because scripts cannot return values
questions.explanation: Only what the script prints or returns goes back to the model. The prices stay in the sandbox.

questions.prompt: A script calls a tool with arguments that break its schema. What happens?
options: The schema is skipped inside scripts
The call fails the same way a direct call would
questions.explanation: Script calls go through pi's normal tool pipeline, so schemas and guards apply to each call.

questions.prompt: Which of these can a codemode script do?
options: Call fetch on a web address
Call a tool it was given as tools.name(args)
questions.explanation: The sandbox has no file system, network, timers, fetch, process or require. Its only power is calling its tools.
